{"reason":"Broaden the demand-forecast-error branch to accept market-signal-mismatch and lower its bias cutoff from 0.10 to 0.05. This fixes all eight cited costly rows (bias 0.065–0.081 or mismatch) while preserving supplier-delay precedence and existing high-bias matches, improving v1’s 0.708 accuracy and 0.607 recovery without lowering recovered amount.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
